changelog.en: v1.1.5 build 25: full optimization round — songs switch after the URL resolves, so playback starts faster; faster cold start; rotating the phone on cold start no longer rotates the app; delete confirmations use the theme accent again; custom accent no longer shows a fake red; backups are now zip files including music and wallpaper files; live-room vertical swipe feels the same as VOD.
changelog.tw: v1.1.5 build 25：全面優化——點歌解析完再切歌，出聲更快；啟動更快；冷啟動轉手機不再橫屏；刪除確認改回主題色；自訂強調色不再假紅；備份改成 zip（含音樂／壁紙檔案）；直播間豎滑手感與點播統一。
changelog.zh: v1.1.5 build 25：全面优化——点歌解析完再切歌，出声更快；启动更快；冷启动转手机不再横屏；删除确认改回主题色；自定义强调色不再假红；备份改成 zip（含音乐/壁纸文件）；直播间竖滑手感与点播统一。
